sections.text: PCM1::JAK2 was documented in a clinical series of JAK2-fusion myeloid neoplasms presenting in chronic or blast phase, often with marrow fibrosis and abnormal erythropoiesis.

sections.text: In a series including eight PCM1::JAK2 and one BCR::JAK2 case, ruxolitinib produced hematologic or cytogenetic responses in some patients, but most discontinued for resistance, progression or planned transplantation.

report_comment.text: PCM1 encodes a centrosomal-satellite scaffold protein. JAK2 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that transduces cytokine-receptor signals. PCM1::JAK2 was documented in a clinical series of JAK2-fusion myeloid neoplasms presenting in chronic or blast phase, often with marrow fibrosis and abnormal erythropoiesis. In a series including eight PCM1::JAK2 and one BCR::JAK2 case, ruxolitinib produced hematologic or cytogenetic responses in some patients, but most discontinued for resistance, progression or planned transplantation.
